questions.question: The best way to be seen by other drivers is to:
answers: Wear bright/reflective gear and use headlights

questions.question: When braking on a motorcycle in a straight line:
answers: Use both front and rear brakes smoothly

questions.question: A motorcycle needs more distance to stop when:
answers: Surfaces are wet, gravelly, or oily

questions.question: Countersteering means:
answers: Turning the bars opposite the desired lean at speed to initiate a turn

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a motorcycle:
answers: Signal and check mirrors and blind spots

questions.question: Carrying a passenger requires:
answers: Proper footpegs, adjusted suspension, and smooth control

questions.question: Group riding is safest when:
answers: Riders use a staggered formation with safe spacing

questions.question: At night, motorcyclists should:
answers: Use high beams constantly even oncoming
Increase following distance and watch for animals/debris

questions.question: A skid on the rear wheel is often corrected by:
answers: Easing off the rear brake and steering straight

questions.question: Eye protection while riding is:
answers: Important to protect from wind, debris, and insects
